subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which compatibility-safe Feishu bind grammar should this PR or the linked candidate cluster preserve before any candidate lands?
rationale: The bug target is valid, but changing `feishu:<value>` from an account bind to a peer bind is a public CLI/config behavior choice with message-routing and upgrade impact that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer syntax
options.body: Keep the documented `<channel>:<account>` meaning and add a documented peer/conversation form for Feishu group IDs before merge.

options.title: Recognize Feishu conversation IDs only
options.body: Keep account names intact while mapping only proven Feishu conversation-id patterns such as group or user IDs into `match.peer`.

options.title: Accept the new default with migration proof
options.body: Allow `feishu:<value>` to mean group peer only if maintainers explicitly accept the break and require docs plus upgrade guidance.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer syntax
recommendation.body: Keep the documented `<channel>:<account>` meaning and add a documented peer/conversation form for Feishu group IDs before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced the account-scoped bind command surface that the decision would change.
